## First release

- A bubble docked at the screen edge: pull it out, point it at a word in any app and the entry appears next to it.
- Cloud text recognition with an instant on-device draft, or the app's own text where it is available.
- Yomitan dictionaries, looked up, sorted and rendered the way Yomitan does it: deinflection, furigana, frequencies, pitch accent, images and kanji entries.
- Jitendex, a frequency list and pitch accents are bundled; more dictionaries come from the download catalog, from `.zip` files or from a Yomitan collection export.
- Anki notes through AnkiDroid with your deck, note type and field templates, duplicate checks, audio and cropped screenshots.
- A search screen and "Look up in Screenlate" in the text selection menu.
- Settings import from a Yomitan settings export.
- The popup's font, text size and custom CSS; light and dark themes; English and Russian interface.
- Updates from GitHub Releases inside the app.

Download `arm64-v8a` for most phones, `armeabi-v7a` for older 32-bit devices, or the universal APK. Android 11 or newer.
